shared_elements: low-relief human figures in strict profile
long curled/braided beard and elaborate coiffure or headdress
figures with arms extended forward holding or gesturing
narrative frieze on a flat panel
justification: Both show shallow-relief bearded male figures in strict profile with elaborate headgear, patterned long garments and outstretched arms, and both include stylized floral/rosette ornament and a profile quadruped, which is a fairly specific shared repertoire of court relief imagery. The biggest differences are the compositional schemes: A is a multi-register frieze of processing attendants and a horse-drawn chariot with a crenellated architectural top and rosette borders, while B is a single large winged figure grasping a rearing beast beside a stylized plant, a combat/blessing motif absent in A.
